      div.onclick=()=>{ input.value=item.num; lista.classList.add('hidden'); };
      lista.appendChild(div);
    });
    lista.classList.remove('hidden');
  };

  function initCarousel(){
    const imgEl=document.getElementById('v162-car-main');
    const dotsEl=document.getElementById('v162-dots');
    if(!imgEl||!dotsEl) return;
    dotsEl.innerHTML='';
    carouselImgs.forEach((_,i)=>{ const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className=i===0?'w-7 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow':'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/40'; d.id='v162-dot-'+i; dotsEl.appendChild(d); });
    setInterval(()=>{ carIdx=(carIdx+1)%carouselImgs.length; imgEl.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>{ imgEl.src=carouselImgs[carIdx]; imgEl.style.opacity='1'; },250); carouselImgs.forEach((_,i)=>{ const dot=document.getElementById('v162-dot-'+i); if(dot) dot.className=i===carIdx?'w-7 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow':'w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white/40'; }); },5000);
  }
  window.v162_setCar=function(i){ carIdx=i%carouselImgs.length; const imgEl=document.getElementById('v162-car-main'); if(imgEl){ imgEl.src=carouselImgs[carIdx]; } };
  window.v162_next=function(){ carIdx=(carIdx+1)%carouselImgs.length; v162_setCar(carIdx); };
  window.v162_prev=function(){ carIdx=(carIdx-1+carouselImgs.length)%carouselImgs.length; v162_setCar(carIdx); };

  window.v162_showLogin=function(){ document.getElementById('welcome-landing').classList.add('hidden'); document.getElementById('login-screen').classList.remove('hidden'); v162_fixLogin(); };
  window.v162_goWelcome=function(){ document.getElementById('welcome-landing').classList.remove('hidden'); document.getElementById('login-screen').classList.add('hidden'); };

  function v162_fixLogin(){
    const ls=document.getElementById('login-screen');
    if(!ls) return;
    ls.innerHTML=`<div class="w-full max-w-[420px] mx-auto bg-white rounded-[24px] p-6 shadow-2xl border mt-10">
      <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3"><button onclick="v162_goWelcome()" class="text-[11px] bg-gray-100 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full">← Bienvenida</button><span class="bg-slate-900 text-white text-[10px] px-3 py-1 rounded-full">${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('es-DO')}</span></div>
      <div class="text-center mb-4"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," style="width:240px; margin:0 auto; border-radius:12px;"><p class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-2">Ya tengo cuenta - Entrar con correo y contraseña</p></div>
      <div class="space-y-3">
        <div><label class="block text-[11px] font-bold mb-1">Correo electrónico</label><input id="login-usuario" type="email" placeholder="ejemplo@mail.com" class="w-full border rounded-full px-4 py-3 text-[14px]"></div>
        <div><label class="block text-[11px] font-bold mb-1">Contraseña</label><div class="relative"><input id="login-password" type="password" placeholder="" class="w-full border rounded-full px-4 py-3 pr-12 text-[14px]"><button type="button" onclick="v162_togglePass()" class="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400">👁</button></div></div>
        <div id="login-error" class="hidden text-red-600 text-[11px] bg-red-50 p-2 rounded-full"></div>
        <button onclick="intentarLogin()" class="w-full bg-[#0f2440] text-white font-bold py-3 rounded-full">Entrar</button>
        <button onclick="v162_goWelcome()" class="w-full border text-[11px] py-2.5 rounded-full mt-2">Crear cuenta - Nombre apellido celular correo contraseña</button>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
  window.v162_togglePass=function(){ const p=document.getElementById('login-password'); if(p) p.type=p.type==='password'?'text':'password'; };
  window.v162_registrar=function(){
    const nom=document.getElementById('v162-reg-nombre')?.value.trim(); const ape=document.getElementById('v162-reg-apellido')?.value.trim(); const cel=document.getElementById('v162-reg-celular')?.value.trim(); const email=document.getElementById('v162-reg-email')?.value.trim(); const pass=document.getElementById('v162-reg-pass')?.value.trim(); const pass2=document.getElementById('v162-reg-pass2')?.value.trim(); const tipo=document.getElementById('v162-reg-tipo')?.value||'REMITENTE';
    if(!nom||!ape||!cel||!email||!pass){ alert('Complete nombre, apellido, celular, correo, contraseña'); return; }
    if(pass!==pass2){ alert('Contraseña no coincide con confirmar contraseña'); return; }
    const nuevo={id:'REM-'+Date.now().toString().slice(-5), codigo:'REM-'+Date.now().toString().slice(-5), nombre:nom+' '+ape, name:nom+' '+ape, telefono:cel, celular:cel, email:email, usuario:email, password:pass, password2:cel, role:tipo, fecha:new Date().toLocaleString('es-DO')};
    if(typeof REMITENTES!=='undefined') REMITENTES.unshift(nuevo);
    try{ let regs=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sendwayo_express_oficial_20261029_registros')||'[]'); regs.unshift(nuevo); localStorage.setItem('sendwayo_express_oficial_20261029_registros', JSON.stringify(regs)); }catch(e){}
    try{ if(typeof addNotificacion==='function') addNotificacion(`Nuevo registro: ${nom} ${ape} - ${cel} - ${email} - ${tipo} - Notificación al admin para seguimiento`, 'Registro'); }catch(e){}
    alert(`Cuenta creada: ${nom} ${ape} - ${email} - Notificación enviada al administrador`);
    v162_showLogin();
  };

  window.intentarLogin=function(){
    const u=document.getElementById('login-usuario')?.value.trim()||''; const p=document.getElementById('login-password')?.value.trim()||''; const err=document.getElementById('login-error');
    if(!u||!p){ if(err){ err.innerText='Ponga correo y contraseña'; err.classList.remove('hidden'); } return; }
    const allUsers=[...(window.USUARIOS_LOGIN||[]), ...JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sendwayo_express_oficial_20261029_registros')||'[]')];
    const user=allUsers.find(x=> (x.usuario&&x.usuario.toLowerCase()===u.toLowerCase()) || (x.email&&x.email.toLowerCase()===u.toLowerCase()) || x.id.toLowerCase()===u.toLowerCase() || x.celular===u);
    if(!user){ if(err){ err.innerText='Usuario no encontrado - Cree cuenta en bienvenida'; err.classList.remove('hidden'); } return; }
    const valids=[user.password, user.password2, user.celular, user.telefono].filter(Boolean);
    if(!valids.includes(p)){ if(err){ err.innerText='Contraseña incorrecta'; err.classList.remove('hidden'); } return; }
    window.currentUser={id:user.id, name:user.nombre, nombre:user.nombre, role:user.role, email:user.usuario||user.email, celular:user.celular, codigo:user.codigo};
    document.getElementById('login-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('welcome-landing').classList.add('hidden');
    const topUser=document.getElementById('user-top'); if(topUser) topUser.innerText=user.nombre+' '+user.codigo;
    document.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>{ b.disabled=false; b.style.pointerEvents='auto'; b.style.opacity='1'; });
    if(typeof renderPrincipal==='function') renderPrincipal();
  };
  window.cerrarSesion=function(){ if(confirm('Cerrar sesion?')){ document.getElementById('login-screen').classList.add('hidden'); document.getElementById('welcome-landing').classList.remove('hidden'); } };

  if(typeof BENEFICIARIOS==='undefined') window.BENEFICIARIOS=[];
  try{ const s=localStorage.getItem('sendwayo_express_oficial_20261029_ben_v162'); if(s){ const arr=JSON.parse(s); const ids=new Set(BENEFICIARIOS.map(b=>b.id)); arr.forEach(b=>{ if(!ids.has(b.id)) BENEFICIARIOS.unshift(b); }); } }catch(e){}
  if (BENEFICIARIOS.length === 0) {}
  function saveBen(){ try{localStorage.setItem('sendwayo_express_oficial_20261029_ben_v162', JSON.stringify(BENEFICIARIOS));}catch(e){} }

  window.v162_renderBen=function(){
    const view=document.getElementById('view-beneficiarios'); if(!view) return;
    view.innerHTML=`<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border p-4"><div class="flex gap-2 mb-2"><span class="bg-[#0f2d5a] text-yellow-300 text-[11px] px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full">Tasa RD→HT: 2.10</span><span class="bg-[#0f3d2e] text-yellow-300 text-[11px] px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full">Tasa HT→RD: 2.30</span></div><div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-[11px] border-t pt-2"><div>Balance Gourdes ${window.v162_bal.htg} HTG - HT→HT va a gourdes</div><div>Balance Pesos RD$ ${window.v162_bal.rd} - RD→HT va a pesos</div><div>Comision RD$ ${window.v162_bal.comRD} / HTG ${window.v162_bal.comHTG}</div></div></div><div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border p-4 flex justify-between mt-3 items-center"><h2 class="font-bold text-[14px]">Beneficiarios - Agregar nuevo beneficiario - Restaurado con dirección y activo/inactivo</h2><div class="flex gap-2 items-center"><input placeholder="Buscar... search by phone" class="border rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-[11px] w-[200px]" onkeyup="v162_filtrarBen(this.value)"><button type="button" onclick="v162_abrirBen('beneficiarios')" class="bg-[#0f2440] text-white text-[11px] px-5 py-2 rounded-full font-bold cursor-pointer" aria-label="Agregar nuevo beneficiario">+ Agregar nuevo beneficiario</button><button class="bg-green-600 text-white text-[10px] px-3 py-2 rounded-full">Excel</button><button class="bg-red-600 text-white text-[10px] px-3 py-2 rounded-full">PDF</button><button class="bg-blue-600 text-white text-[10px] px-3 py-2 rounded-full">CSV</button></div></div><div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border mt-3 overflow-x-auto"><table class="w-full text-[11px]"><thead class="bg-gray-50"><tr><th class="p-3 rounded-l-full">N°</th><th class="p-2">NOMBRE</th><th class="p-2">TELÉFONO</th><th class="p-2">DIRECCIÓN</th><th class="p-2">ESTADO</th><th class="p-3 rounded-r-full">ACCIONES</th></tr></thead><tbody id="v162-tabla-ben"></tbody></table></div>`;
    const tbody=document.getElementById('v162-tabla-ben'); tbody.innerHTML=''; BENEFICIARIOS.forEach((b,idx)=>{ const tr=document.createElement('tr'); tr.className='border-b'; tr.innerHTML=`<td class="p-3 font-bold">${String(idx+1).padStart(2,'0')}</td><td class="p-2 font-bold">${b.nombre}</td><td class="p-2">${b.telefonoCompleto}</td><td class="p-2">${b.direccion}</td><td class="p-2"><span class="bg-green-100 text-green-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[9px]">${b.estado}</span></td><td class="p-2"><button onclick="v162_borrarBen('${b.id}')" class="bg-red-600 text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-[9px]">Borrar</button></td>`; tbody.appendChild(tr); });
  };
  window.v162_abrirBen=function(o){ window._v162_origen=o; document.getElementById('modal-beneficiario-v162').classList.remove('hidden'); };
  window.abrirModalBeneficiario=window.v162_abrirBen;
  window.v162_guardarBen=function(){ const n=document.getElementById('v162-ben-nom').value.trim(); const pa=document.getElementById('v162-ben-pais').value; const te=document.getElementById('v162-ben-tel').value.trim(); const di=document.getElementById('v162-ben-dir').value.trim(); const es=document.getElementById('v162-ben-est').value; if(!n||!te){alert('Complete'); return;} const telC=`${pa} ${te}`; BENEFICIARIOS.unshift({id:'BEN-'+Date.now().toString().slice(-5), nombre:n, telefono:te, codigoPais:pa, telefonoCompleto:telC, direccion:di, estado:es}); saveBen(); v162_renderBen(); document.getElementById('modal-beneficiario-v162').classList.add('hidden'); if(window._v162_origen==='envio') document.getElementById('v162-envio-ben').value=`${telC} (${n})`; else if(window._v162_origen==='retiro') document.getElementById('v162-retiro-ben').value=`${telC} (${n})`; };
  window.v162_borrarBen=function(id){ BENEFICIARIOS=BENEFICIARIOS.filter(x=>x.id!==id); saveBen(); v162_renderBen(); };
  window.v162_filtrarBen=function(t){ const tb=document.getElementById('v162-tabla-ben'); if(!tb) return; tb.querySelectorAll('tr').forEach(tr=>{ tr.style.display=tr.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(t.toLowerCase())?'':'none'; }); };

  window.v162_sug=function(tipo, modulo){
    const map={ 'envio':{rem:'v162-envio-rem', ben:'v162-envio-ben', sRem:'v162-sug-rem-envio', sBen:'v162-sug-ben-envio'}, 'retiro':{rem:'v162-retiro-rem', ben:'v162-retiro-ben', sRem:'v162-sug-rem-retiro', sBen:'v162-sug-ben-retiro'}, 'paquetes':{ben:'v162-paq-rec', sBen:'v162-sug-ben-paquetes'}, 'recargas':{ben:'v162-rec-ben', sBen:'v162-sug-ben-recargas'}, 'paquetikos':{ben:'v162-pkt-rec', sBen:'v162-sug-ben-paquetikos'}, 'facturas':{ben:'v162-fac-ben', sBen:'v162-sug-ben-facturas'}, 'comisiones':{rem:'v162-com-rem', sRem:'v162-sug-rem-comisiones'} };
    const cfg=map[modulo]; if(!cfg) return; const inputId=tipo==='remitente'?cfg.rem:cfg.ben; const listaId=tipo==='remitente'?cfg.sRem:cfg.sBen; const input=document.getElementById(inputId); const lista=document.getElementById(listaId); if(!input||!lista) return;
    const val=input.value.toLowerCase(); let fuente=tipo==='remitente'?(typeof REMITENTES!=='undefined'?REMITENTES:[]):BENEFICIARIOS;
    let filtrados=val.length===0?fuente.slice(0,8):fuente.filter(b=> (b.nombre||b.name||'').toLowerCase().includes(val) || (b.telefonoCompleto||b.telefono||b.celular||'').toLowerCase().includes(val));
    if(filtrados.length===0){ lista.classList.add('hidden'); return; }
    lista.innerHTML=''; filtrados.slice(0,8).forEach(b=>{ const div=document.createElement('div'); div.className='p-3 hover:bg-blue-50 cursor-pointer border-b text-[11px] rounded-full'; const nombre=b.nombre||b.name||''; const tel=b.telefonoCompleto||b.telefono||b.celular||''; div.innerHTML=`<div class="font-bold">${nombre} - ${tel}</div><div class="text-[9px] text-gray-500">Sugerencia: ${tel}</div>`; div.onclick=()=>{ input.value=`${tel} (${nombre})`; lista.classList.add('hidden'); }; lista.appendChild(div); }); lista.classList.remove('hidden');
  };
  window.v162_abrirRem=function(o){ window._v162_origenRem=o; document.getElementById('modal-remitente-v162').classList.remove('hidden'); };
  window.v162_guardarRem=function(){ const n=document.getElementById('v162-rem-nom').value.trim(); const t=document.getElementById('v162-rem-tel').value.trim(); if(!n||!t){alert('Complete'); return;} const nuevo={id:'REM-'+Date.now().toString().slice(-4), codigo:'REM-'+Date.now().toString().slice(-4), name:n, nombre:n, telefono:t, celular:t}; if(typeof REMITENTES!=='undefined') REMITENTES.unshift(nuevo); document.getElementById('modal-remitente-v162').classList.add('hidden'); if(window._v162_origenRem==='envio') document.getElementById('v162-envio-rem').value=`${t} (${n})`; else if(window._v162_origenRem==='retiro') document.getElementById('v162-retiro-rem').value=`${t} (${n})`; };

  window.v162_setRetiro=function(ruta){ document.getElementById('v162-retiro-ruta').value=ruta; v162_onRetiroRuta(); };
  window.v162_onEnvioRuta=function(){ const r=document.getElementById('v162-envio-ruta')?.value||''; const label=document.getElementById('v162-envio-monto-label'); if(r.includes('HT → HT')){ if(label) label.innerText='MONTO EN (GOURDES HAITIANO - HTG)'; } else { if(label) label.innerText='MONTO EN (RD$) - PESOS DOMINICANO'; } v162_calcEnvio(); };
  window.v162_onRetiroRuta=function(){ const r=document.getElementById('v162-retiro-ruta')?.value||''; const label=document.getElementById('v162-retiro-monto-label'); if(r.includes('HT → HT')){ if(label) label.innerText='MONTO EN (GOURDES HAITIANO - HTG) - Retiro Haití a Haití moneda gourdes - Naca a Naca Moncash'; } else { if(label) label.innerText='MONTO EN (RD$) - PESOS DOMINICANO'; } v162_calcRetiro(); };
  window.v162_depMoneda=function(){ const mon=document.getElementById('v162-dep-moneda')?.value||'PESOS'; const label=document.getElementById('v162-dep-monto-label'); const cuenta=document.getElementById('v162-dep-cuenta'); if(mon==='GOURDES'){ if(label) label.innerText='MONTO EN (GOURDES HAITIANO - HTG)'; if(cuenta) cuenta.value='NatCash Haiti - 509 4170 2368 - HTG'; } else { if(label) label.innerText='MONTO EN (PESOS DOMINICANO - RD$)'; if(cuenta) cuenta.value='Banco Popular - 775456123 - RD$'; } };

  window.v162_calcEnvio=function(){ const monto=parseFloat(document.getElementById('v162-envio-monto')?.value)||0; const ruta=document.getElementById('v162-envio-ruta')?.value||''; let fee=0, neto=0, rec=''; if(ruta.includes('HT → HT')){ fee=v162_getFeeEnvioHT(monto); neto=monto-fee; rec=neto.toFixed(2)+' HTG'; document.getElementById('v162-envio-neto').innerText=neto.toFixed(2)+' HTG'; document.getElementById('v162-envio-com').innerText=fee.toFixed(2)+' HTG'; } else { fee=Math.round(monto*0.08); neto=monto-fee; rec=ruta.includes('RD → HT')?(neto*2.10).toFixed(2)+' HTG':neto.toFixed(2)+' DOP'; document.getElementById('v162-envio-neto').innerText=neto.toFixed(2)+' RD$'; document.getElementById('v162-envio-com').innerText=fee.toFixed(2)+' RD$'; } document.getElementById('v162-envio-rec').innerText=rec; document.getElementById('v162-envio-tasa').innerText=ruta.includes('HT → HT')?`( Fee ${fee} HTG )`:`( Tasa 2.10 )`; const el=document.getElementById('v162-envio-monto'); if(el){ el.dataset.neto=neto; el.dataset.fee=fee; el.dataset.rec=rec; el.dataset.esHT=ruta.includes('HT → HT')?'1':'0'; } };
  window.v162_calcRetiro=function(){ const monto=parseFloat(document.getElementById('v162-retiro-monto')?.value)||0; const ruta=document.getElementById('v162-retiro-ruta')?.value||''; let fee=0, neto=0, rec=''; if(ruta.includes('HT → HT')){ fee=v162_getFeeRetiroHT(monto); neto=monto-fee; rec=neto.toFixed(2)+' HTG'; document.getElementById('v162-retiro-neto').innerText=neto.toFixed(2)+' HTG'; document.getElementById('v162-retiro-com').innerText=fee.toFixed(2)+' HTG'; } else { fee=Math.round(monto*0.08); neto=monto-fee; rec=neto.toFixed(2)+' DOP'; document.getElementById('v162-retiro-neto').innerText=neto.toFixed(2)+' RD$'; document.getElementById('v162-retiro-com').innerText=fee.toFixed(2)+' RD$'; } document.getElementById('v162-retiro-rec').innerText=rec; document.getElementById('v162-retiro-tasa').innerText=ruta.includes('HT → HT')?`( Fee Retrait ${fee} HTG Gourdes Naca Montcash )`:`( 8% Pesos )`; const el=document.getElementById('v162-retiro-monto'); if(el){ el.dataset.neto=neto; el.dataset.fee=fee; el.dataset.rec=rec; el.dataset.esHT=ruta.includes('HT → HT')?'1':'0'; } };
